assertion_results.text: Dependency chain context identifies openssl-libs as present in rpms.lock.yaml and uses this to determine the package origin — the lock file presence is the primary classification signal (Step 2.3.5)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md dependency chain section: 'rpms.lock.yaml: present -- explicit install', 'Origin: explicit install (openssl-libs specified in rpms.lock.yaml)', and 'The rpms.lock.yaml classification is used as the sole source of truth for package origin.'

assertion_results.text: Remediation creates a single task for the Konflux release repo — not the two-task upstream backport + downstream propagation flow used for source dependency ecosystems (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation — system package path)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md line 13: '**Tasks per stream**: 1 (Konflux release repo fix only)'. Only one remediation task is created targeting 'rhtpa-release.0.4.z'. No upstream backport task exists in the output.

assertion_results.text: Remediation task description follows task-description-template.md format with Repository, Target Branch, Description, Implementation Notes, and Acceptance Criteria sections — Files to Modify is intentionally omitted per remediation-templates.md (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md task description contains all required sections: '## Repository' (line 30, rhtpa-release.0.4.z), '## Target Branch' (line 34, main), '## Description' (line 38), '## Implementation Notes' (line 54), '## Acceptance Criteria' (line 71). No 'Files to Modify' section is present anywhere in the task description.
